#### `certificate`

**Type: `string | Uint8Array | string[] | Uint8Array[]`**

**Note:**
> - The option has been renamed from the [`cert` TLS option](https://nodejs.org/api/tls.html#tls_tls_createsecurecontext_options) for better readability.

[Certificate chains](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X.509#Certificate_chains_and_cross-certification) in [PEM format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Privacy-Enhanced_Mail).

One certificate chain should be provided per private key.

When providing multiple certificate chains, they do not have to be in the same order as their private keys in `https.key`.

#### `certificateRevocationLists`

**Type: `string | Uint8Array | string[] | Uint8Array[]`**

**Note:**
> - The option has been renamed from the [`crl` TLS option](https://nodejs.org/api/tls.html#tls_tls_createsecurecontext_options) for better readability.

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
